title: Receipts Clearing House — Shortcut → Apps Script POST body (Pass 1 capture)
description: JSON the iOS Shortcut sends to the Apps Script /exec endpoint via Get Contents of URL (POST, Request Body = JSON). The Apps Script doPost() reads e.postData.contents and parses this. Snap-and-go: only token + imageBase64 are required; vendor/category are filled later by the Pass 2 home-host vision LLM (see docs/adr/0004).

token.description: Shared secret. Must equal the SHARED_TOKEN script property or the write is rejected (401-style {ok:false,error:'unauthorized'}).

total.description: Provisional total from the on-device heuristic (largest currency amount), e.g. 47.32. Blank/absent if nothing matched. Sent as a number; string also accepted and coerced. Pass 2 may overwrite with a corrected value.

entity.description: Optional, user-selected at capture. Absent/empty -> Apps Script stores 'Unassigned'. 'SPLIT' makes Apps Script set Needs Split = TRUE. Never filled by Pass 2 (the receipt can't reveal the cost-center bucket).

note.description: Optional free text. Defaults to empty.

date.description: Receipt date from the on-device heuristic (first date token). Defaults to today (yyyy-MM-dd) if absent.

imageBase64.description: The captured receipt photo, Base64-encoded (Shortcuts 'Base64 Encode' action). Apps Script decodes -> Drive. Pass 2 reads this image back from Drive.

imageMime.description: MIME type of the encoded image. 'image/jpeg' for Take Photo / Scan Document JPEG output.
